market_message: AEMO is requesting MOS increase offers and MOS decrease offers from eligible trading right holders for each STTM pipeline for the November 2026 MOS period. MOS increase offers and MOS decrease offers will be accepted for the November 2026 MOS period until 5:00pm AEST on gas day 21/10/2026. Please refer to the STTM Web Exchange User Guide v1.5, Section 3.7.6 (STTM Pipeline Operator MOS Offer Requirements), which specifies the contract types that must be referenced when submitting MOS Increase Offers and MOS Decrease Offers for each STTM pipeline. For full details go to:http://www.aemo.com.au/Gas/Short-Term-Trading-Market-STTM/Market-operations/Market_Operator_Service
